metaTitle.comment: Home page document title. Shown in the browser tab and as the Google result title. Keep it under ~60 characters.

metaDescription.comment: Home page search-result snippet. One or two sentences, under ~160 characters. Must be unique per language.
metaDescription.en: A small static page in English, with Danish and Arabic versions, built to show multilingual URLs and SEO.
metaDescription.da: En lille statisk side på dansk, med engelsk og arabisk version, der viser flersprogede URL’er og SEO.
metaDescription.ar: صفحة ثابتة صغيرة بالعربية، مع نسختين بالإنجليزية والدنماركية، لعرض عناوين URL متعددة اللغات وتحسين الظهور في البحث.

heading.comment: Visible H1 on the home page. Real HTML text, not an image, so search engines can read it.

body.comment: Main paragraph on the home page. Write naturally in this language; do not leave English and translate word-for-word.
body.en: This is a small static website. Each language has its own URL so people and search engines can find the page in their own language.
body.da: Dette er et lille statisk website. Hvert sprog har sin egen URL, så mennesker og søgemaskiner kan finde siden på deres eget sprog.
body.ar: هذا موقع ثابت صغير. لكل لغة عنوان URL خاص بها حتى يتمكن الأشخاص ومحركات البحث من العثور على الصفحة بلغتهم.

imageAlt.comment: alt text for the home page hero image. Describe the image in this language. If the image contains words, include those words here.
imageAlt.en: Cartoon cow, dog, and cat under the words Hello world
imageAlt.da: Tegnet ko, hund og kat under ordene Hej verden
imageAlt.ar: بقرة وكلب وقطة كرتونية تحت عبارة مرحبا بالعالم

languageNavLabel.comment: Accessible name of the language switcher. Translate this; the language names themselves stay in their native form.

footerNavLabel.comment: Accessible name of the footer link list.

footerTerms.comment: Footer link to the Terms page. Translate the label even though the Terms document itself stays in English.

footerSupport.comment: Footer link to the Support page.

supportMetaTitle.comment: Support page document title. Keep it under ~60 characters.

supportMetaDescription.comment: Support page search-result snippet. Unique per language, under ~160 characters.
supportMetaDescription.en: Having trouble with Hello World? Refresh the page, check your spelling, or email hello@example.com.
supportMetaDescription.da: Problemer med Hello World? Opdater siden, tjek stavningen, eller skriv til hello@example.com.
supportMetaDescription.ar: مشكلة مع Hello World؟ حدّث الصفحة، راجع الإملاء، أو راسل hello@example.com.

supportHeading.comment: Visible H1 on the Support page.

supportIntro.comment: Opening line on the Support page. Keep Hello World as the product name.
supportIntro.da: Har du problemer med Hello World?

supportLead.ar: جرّب تقنيات استكشاف الأخطاء المتقدمة هذه:

supportStep1Title.comment: First troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.

supportStep1Body.en: The oldest trick in the book.

supportStep2Title.comment: Second troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.

supportStep2Body.comment: Second troubleshooting step body. Keep Hello World in quotes as the product phrase.
supportStep2Body.en: “Hello World” is very particular about its letters.
supportStep2Body.da: “Hello World” er meget kræsen med sine bogstaver.
supportStep2Body.ar: عبارة “Hello World” صارمة جداً في حروفها.

supportStep3Title.comment: Third troubleshooting step title. Keep the number.
supportStep3Title.en: 3. Try turning it off and on again.
supportStep3Title.da: 3. Prøv at slukke og tænde igen.
supportStep3Title.ar: 3. جرّب إطفاء الجهاز وتشغيله من جديد.

supportContact.comment: Keep the {email} placeholder exactly. The build replaces it with a mailto link.
supportContact.en: Still stuck? Contact us at {email} and describe what went wrong.
supportContact.da: Sidder du stadig fast? Kontakt os på {email} og fortæl, hvad der gik galt.
supportContact.ar: ما زلت عالقاً؟ تواصل معنا على {email} واشرح ما الذي حدث.

supportEvidence.comment: Final paragraph on the Support page.
supportEvidence.en: Please include screenshots, error messages, and your best guess at what the computer is angry about.
supportEvidence.da: Vedhæft gerne skærmbilleder, fejlmeddelelser og dit bedste bud på, hvad computeren er sur over.
supportEvidence.ar: أرفق لقطات شاشة ورسائل الخطأ وأفضل تخمين لديك حول سبب غضب الحاسوب.
